specialIssues.title: Large Language Models in Scientific Discovery
specialIssues.description:
This special issue invites original research and review articles exploring the transformative role of large language models (LLMs) in scientific discovery, from drug design to materials science and beyond. We welcome computational studies, benchmark datasets, novel architectures, and empirical evaluations demonstrating real-world scientific impact.

Topics include but are not limited to protein language models, chemical foundation models, LLM-assisted hypothesis generation, automated literature review, and explainability in AI-driven science.

specialIssues.title: Trustworthy AI: Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency
specialIssues.description:
As AI systems become embedded in high-stakes decisions across healthcare, criminal justice, hiring, and finance, ensuring they are fair, accountable, and transparent has never been more critical. This special issue brings together interdisciplinary research at the intersection of machine learning, ethics, law, and social science.

We seek submissions covering bias detection and mitigation, interpretability methods, regulatory compliance, auditing frameworks, and participatory design.

specialIssues.title: Immunotherapy Combinations in Solid Tumors
specialIssues.description: Combination immunotherapy approaches — pairing checkpoint inhibitors with targeted therapies, cellular therapies, or novel immuno-oncology agents — have reshaped the treatment landscape for solid tumors. This special issue presents the latest clinical trial data, translational studies, and mechanistic insights driving this rapidly evolving field.

specialIssues.title: Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Tumor DNA
specialIssues.description: Liquid biopsy has emerged as a transformative diagnostic tool enabling non-invasive cancer detection, minimal residual disease monitoring, and real-time tracking of tumor evolution. This special issue focuses on the clinical validation, analytical standards, and emerging applications of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) and other liquid biopsy analytes.

specialIssues.title: Single-Cell Multiomics: Integrating Transcriptomics, Epigenomics, and Proteomics
specialIssues.description: Single-cell technologies have revolutionized our ability to dissect cellular heterogeneity. This landmark special issue compiles pioneering work integrating transcriptomic, epigenomic, and proteomic measurements at single-cell resolution, enabling unprecedented insights into cell identity, developmental trajectories, and disease mechanisms.

specialIssues.title: Next-Generation Battery Materials for Energy Transition
specialIssues.description: The global energy transition demands breakthroughs in energy storage. This special issue focuses on advanced materials for next-generation batteries — solid-state electrolytes, lithium-metal anodes, sodium-ion cathodes, and beyond-lithium chemistries — with emphasis on both fundamental science and scale-up to manufacturing.

specialIssues.title: Climate Change and Human Health: A Global Burden
specialIssues.description: Climate change represents one of the greatest threats to human health in the 21st century. This Lancet special issue presents a comprehensive analysis of direct and indirect health impacts — from extreme heat and vector-borne disease expansion to food insecurity and mental health — alongside health system adaptation strategies and mitigation co-benefits.

specialIssues.title: Universal Health Coverage: Progress, Gaps, and Pathways
specialIssues.description: With 2030 SDG targets approaching, this special issue critically evaluates global progress toward universal health coverage. Drawing on health systems research, economic modelling, and country case studies, we examine financing mechanisms, workforce challenges, primary care strengthening, and the role of digital health in closing coverage gaps.

specialIssues.title: Catalysis for a Sustainable Future
specialIssues.description: Catalysis is central to sustainable chemistry — enabling green synthesis, CO2 utilisation, hydrogen production, and waste valorisation. This special issue highlights cutting-edge catalytic systems, from enzyme-inspired organocatalysts and earth-abundant metal complexes to photocatalytic and electrocatalytic approaches addressing global sustainability challenges.

specialIssues.title: The Neuroscience of Consciousness: From Mechanisms to Disorders
specialIssues.description: Consciousness remains one of the most profound mysteries in science. This special issue surveys the current state of consciousness research — from neural correlates and theoretical frameworks (IIT, GWT, Predictive Coding) to disorders of consciousness such as coma, vegetative state, and anaesthetic mechanisms, with emerging applications in neuroprosthetics and AI.
